title: A member asks a question, and the app opens the page that answers it

criteria.text: Ask bar: one text box on every signed-in page that takes a question in plain words
criteria.note: Not built. Rechecked 2026-11-27 [V grep, gh pr list --search F119]: no ask bar, router, page registry or question log in src; no PR has built any of F119. Open #1192.

criteria.text: Routing: one cheap model call turns the question into one page plus its filters, and the app opens it
criteria.note: Not built: the only model calls are moderation (F100) and problem-report triage [V grep]. #1459 (11-26) removed Explore's map and says the map returns as part of an answer under F119 (the 2026-11-25 F059 ruling) [V PR body]. Open #1193 (needs-pm).

criteria.text: Fallback: if the call fails, times out or finds no page, the question runs as an ordinary search
criteria.note: Not built; Explore search (#924) is the fallback it would use [V]. Open #1194.

criteria.text: Deep links: every page and every filter it supports can be reached by URL
criteria.note: Not built as a set: Explore carries `metro`, `area`, `q`, `category`, `schedule` and `reach` (`src/lib/browse/query.ts`) and You `?tab=`; #1459 dropped `?view=map` (it now opens the list) [V]. No prefilled post draft by URL [A]. Open #1195.

criteria.text: One page registry: a single list in the code describes each page, its URL and its filters; the router reads only that list
criteria.note: Not built. Rechecked 2026-11-27 [V grep, gh pr list --search F119]: no ask bar, router, page registry or question log in src; no PR has built any of F119. Open #1196.

criteria.text: Nothing is done for the member: the router only opens pages; a prefilled draft is not posted until the member posts it
criteria.note: Not built; needs a standing guard once the router exists. Open #1197.

criteria.text: Questions logged by the search-demand rules (F089): anonymous, aggregated with a floor of ten members in one metro, raw rows deleted after 30 days, never tied to a member; a member's own questions join their search history (F136)
criteria.note: Not built for questions. Search-demand logging exists for Explore search (`search-demand-actions.ts`) [V grep]; F136's history is open (#1326). Open #1198 (needs-pm).

criteria.text: Opt-out: one setting stops a member's questions being logged; routing still works for them
Cost cap: a per-member daily limit on model calls, after which the bar falls back to search
